prompt: Some university students want to learn about other subjects in addition to their main subjects. Others believe it is more important to give all their time and attention to studying for a qualification. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In the present age, whether students in the university should focus only on the main academic subjects in that field or not has sparked much debate. Some people assert that students have to learn about elective subjects as well, whereas others argue that they should spend all their time on learning main subjects. Personally, I am in favour of the first view.

There are several reasons that support the idea of why students at the college should learn additional subjects, but the most important reason is that students can expand their knowledge. In other words, studying a main subject provides students with in-depth knowledge of one field. while additional subjects could cover a wide range of knowledge. Moreover, students at the university need to be more intelligent and flexible to learn a variety of knowledge, which helps them to build a strong foundation. In addition, students need to learn additional subjects to build a background in different fields, because they will need them in the future. For instance, students who have a variety of knowledge in various fields, become more confident about changing careers if they are not successful in their major field.

I admit that, university students already face enough stress from their main subjects. So they may feel confused and nervous about losing marks in subjects they are not really interested in. Despite that, additional subjects help students become more professional, because they need to manage their time and give their attention to different topics at the same time. That means, they may have plenty of knowledge in different fields, so they become more confident and flexible with others` ideas.

In conclusion, studying elective subjects besides the main subject at the university could be confusing or overwhelming for some students. However, I believe that additional subjects are advisable for students` future careers, for which we have plenty of evidence from our own experience.
